evals.prompt: what was the last us cpi print and when did it come out
evals.expected_output: The latest USD inflation value from `history usd inflation`, with the reference month, the publication time from announcement_datetime_local, and the BLS source link. Mentions the free-tier delay notice if one was returned.

assertions.text: States the publication time separately from the reference period

evals.prompt: anything big on the US calendar this week? need to know before I trade eurusd
evals.expected_output: A list of upcoming USD releases from `calendar usd` within the week, ordered by time, with high-importance or tier-1 releases called out.

evals.prompt: show me the RBA cash rate decisions this year
evals.expected_output: If FXMACRODATA_API_KEY is set, the AUD policy_rate history for this year. If not, an explanation that AUD needs an API key and the link to set FXMACRODATA_API_KEY, without presenting USD data as AUD data.

assertions.text: Uses the policy_rate slug for AUD
Handles a missing key with the settings link
